outcome: Intracranial lesions (subdural hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, intraventricular hemorrhage, cerebral infarct, skull fracture, cephalohematoma)
finding: While SGH is associated with significant morbidity, long-term outcomes for neonates with SGH are generally good, with only arterial blood pH at birth being significantly associated with mortality.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery (vaginal or cesarean) was the most common mode of delivery (70% and 20% respectively) among neonates with SGH.
